key: Hello, Trainer.
en: Hello, Trainer.
ja: こんにちは　トレーナーさん。

key: If you're looking for my brother, I'm afraid he's not in right now.
en: If you're looking for my brother, I'm afraid he's not in right now.
ja: 弟を　お探しなら　残念ですが　今は　留守にしています。

key: ...And I can only hope my son is with him and not off causing trouble again.
en: ...And I can only hope my son is with him and not off causing trouble again.
ja: ……せめて　息子が　弟と　一緒にいて　また　トラブルを　起こしていないことを　願うばかりです。

key: You! You're a Trainer, right?
en: You! You're a Trainer, right?
ja: あなた! トレーナーさんですよね?

key: Please, I'm begging you, do something!
en: Please, I'm begging you, do something!
ja: お願いです　何とかしてください!

key: My son has been kidnapped!
en: My son has been kidnapped!
ja: 息子が　誘拐されたんです!

key: He was missing for a while, but I just assumed he was with my brother on vacation in Spinel Town.
en: He was missing for a while, but I just assumed he was with my brother on vacation in Spinel Town.
ja: しばらく　姿が　見えなかったんですが　弟と　一緒に　スピネルタウンへ　旅行にでも　行っているんだろうと　思っていました。

key: Then just a bit ago, some bald-headed thugs came by and gave me a ransom note!
en: Then just a bit ago, some bald-headed thugs came by and gave me a ransom note!
ja: それが　少し前　スキンヘッドの　ならず者たちが　やってきて　身代金の要求状を　渡していったんです!

key: My brother is a famous musician-- have you heard of Master McKrezzy?
en: My brother is a famous musician-- have you heard of Master McKrezzy?
ja: わたしの弟は　有名な音楽家でして―― マエストロ・マクレジーを　ご存じですか?

key: His album "Do Anorith Dream of Stonefleece Mareep" was a huge hit over in Kalos.
en: His album "Do Anorith Dream of Stonefleece Mareep" was a huge hit over in Kalos.
ja: アルバム「アノプスは　ストーンフリースメリープの　夢を見るか」は　カロスで　大ヒットしたんです。

key: Now they've targeted my son to try and pick at my brother's success!
en: Now they've targeted my son to try and pick at my brother's success!
ja: 今度は　弟の成功に　ケチをつけようと　息子を　狙ってきたんです!

key: I don't know where they've taken him, but please! If you can, track down those bald thugs and save my little Eustace!
en: I don't know where they've taken him, but please! If you can, track down those bald thugs and save my little Eustace!
ja: どこに　連れて行かれたのかは　わかりませんが　どうか! できることなら　あのスキンヘッドの　ならず者たちを　見つけ出して　かわいいユースタスを　助けてください!

key: Thank goodness, my son came back.
en: Thank goodness, my son came back.
ja: ああ　よかった　息子が　帰ってきました。

key: He told me all about his schemes, and how you stopped him.
en: He told me all about his schemes, and how you stopped him.
ja: 彼の企みのことも　あなたが　どうやって　それを　止めてくれたのかも　全部　聞きました。

key: Rest assured, he is thoroughly grounded.
en: Rest assured, he is thoroughly grounded.
ja: ご安心を　しっかり　外出禁止に　してありますから。

key: But I just don't understand why he keeps doing this...
en: But I just don't understand why he keeps doing this...
ja: でも　どうして　あの子が　こんなことを　繰り返すのか　わからないんです……

key: Last time, he set fire to three apartment buildings in the Jasper Ward.
en: Last time, he set fire to three apartment buildings in the Jasper Ward.
ja: 前回は　ジャスパーワードの　アパート三棟に　火を　つけました。

key: And before that, he got the remnants of the Magma Gang together and raided Dr. Connal's Orphanage!
en: And before that, he got the remnants of the Magma Gang together and raided Dr. Connal's Orphanage!
ja: その前は　マグマ団の残党を　かき集めて　コナル博士の孤児院を　襲撃したんです!

key: And before that, he got the remnants of the Aqua Gang together and raided Dr. Connal's Orphanage!
en: And before that, he got the remnants of the Aqua Gang together and raided Dr. Connal's Orphanage!
ja: その前は　アクア団の残党を　かき集めて　コナル博士の孤児院を　襲撃したんです!

key: Now the whole place is shut down because of him!
en: Now the whole place is shut down because of him!
ja: そのせいで　今は　その場所　まるごと　閉鎖されているんです!

key: I just don't understand where we went wrong...
en: I just don't understand where we went wrong...
ja: どこで　子育てを　間違えたのか　本当に　わからなくて……

key: EUSTACE: This sucks.
en: EUSTACE: This sucks.
ja: ユースタス: 最悪だ。

key: I'm grounded and it's all your fault.
en: I'm grounded and it's all your fault.
ja: 外出禁止に　なったの　全部　お前のせいだからな。

key: Why'd you have to go and play hero, huh?
en: Why'd you have to go and play hero, huh?
ja: なんで　わざわざ　ヒーロー気取りに　なったんだよ?

key: Where were you when my Pokémon was stolen?
en: Where were you when my Pokémon was stolen?
ja: 俺のポケモンが　盗まれたとき　お前　どこに　いたんだよ?

key: I should've never left it alone, but my stupid uncle was all "No, you gotta put stuff in the Day Care, it'll get really strong!"
en: I should've never left it alone, but my stupid uncle was all "No, you gotta put stuff in the Day Care, it'll get really strong!"
ja: あんな所に　一人で　置いとくんじゃ　なかったんだ　でも　バカなおじさんが「だめだ　あずかり所に　預ければ　すごく強くなるぞ!」とか　言うから。

key: Ugh! He DESERVES to have his money stolen for tricking me!
en: Ugh! He DESERVES to have his money stolen for tricking me!
ja: くそ! 俺を　だました罰として　お金を　盗まれて　当然なんだよ!

key: Let me go through with my plans next time, you got that?!
en: Let me go through with my plans next time, you got that?!
ja: 次は　俺の計画を　邪魔するなよ　わかったか?!

key: Say, you know how to make a bomb?
en: Say, you know how to make a bomb?
ja: なあ　爆弾の作り方　知ってるか?

key: EUSTACE: I'll come up with a new scheme.
en: EUSTACE: I'll come up with a new scheme.
ja: ユースタス: 新しい企みを　考えてやる。

key: Something guaranteed to bring this city to its knees!
en: Something guaranteed to bring this city to its knees!
ja: この街を　絶対に　ひざまずかせてやる　そういうやつをな!

key: Just watch me!
en: Just watch me!
ja: 見てろよ!

key: In fact, who needs bombs? I can just use Pokémon!
en: In fact, who needs bombs? I can just use Pokémon!
ja: つうか　爆弾なんか　いらねぇ　ポケモンを　使えば　いいんだ!

key: Hey you, you know how you can make it up to me?
en: Hey you, you know how you can make it up to me?
ja: なあ　お前　俺への埋め合わせの　仕方　わかるか?

key: Give me an Electrode.
en: Give me an Electrode.
ja: マルマインを　よこせ。

key: In fact, give me tons of Electrode!
en: In fact, give me tons of Electrode!
ja: つうか　マルマインを　山ほど　よこせ!

key: Really high-leveled ones too!
en: Really high-leveled ones too!
ja: しかも　レベルの高いやつをな!

key: At least level 160!
en: At least level 160!
ja: 最低でも　レベル160だ!

key: EUSTACE: No! That's not strong enough! Not explosive enough! I need more firepower!
en: EUSTACE: No! That's not strong enough! Not explosive enough! I need more firepower!
ja: ユースタス: だめだ! 全然　強くねぇ! 爆発力が　足りねぇんだよ! もっと　火力が　必要だ!

key: EUSTACE: I said an Electrode, you Mankey-brained buffoon! Not--
en: EUSTACE: I said an Electrode, you Mankey-brained buffoon! Not--
ja: ユースタス: マルマインを　よこせって　言ったんだ　このマンキー頭のマヌケ! それは――

key: This is my Vanillite, isn't it?
en: This is my Vanillite, isn't it?
ja: これ　俺のバニプッチじゃねぇか?

key: How did you...
en: How did you...
ja: どうやって　お前……

key: EUSTACE: I guess people can do good things sometimes, too...?
en: EUSTACE: I guess people can do good things sometimes, too...?
ja: ユースタス: 人って　たまには　いいことも　できるもんなんだな……?

key: I've... made a lot of mistakes, huh?
en: I've... made a lot of mistakes, huh?
ja: 俺……　いっぱい　間違ったこと　したよな?

key: Okay.
en: Okay.
ja: わかった。

key: I'll learn from this.
en: I'll learn from this.
ja: これを　教訓にする。

key: I'll try to be a person who does good things.
en: I'll try to be a person who does good things.
ja: いいことを　する人間に　なるよう　努力するよ。

key: Like if I steal my uncle's money and donate it to charity, that counts, right?
en: Like if I steal my uncle's money and donate it to charity, that counts, right?
ja: たとえば　おじさんの金を　盗んで　それを　慈善団体に　寄付したら　それも　いいことに　なるよな?

key: EUSTACE: Ooh, what if I just blow up Citrine Mountain?
en: EUSTACE: Ooh, what if I just blow up Citrine Mountain?
ja: ユースタス: おお　シトリン山を　まるごと　吹っ飛ばしたら　どうだ?

key: Then there'll be lots of room for new homes instead of crowding everyone into this city.
en: Then there'll be lots of room for new homes instead of crowding everyone into this city.
ja: そしたら　みんなを　この街に　詰めこむ代わりに　新しい家を　建てる場所が　いっぱい　できるだろ。

key: That's fine, right?
en: That's fine, right?
ja: それなら　いいよな?
